details: To multiply fractions, multiply numerators together and denominators together: (a / b) * (c / d) = (a * c) / (b * d).
evidence_or_examples: (2/3) * (4/5) = 8/15; Area model with 3/4 x 2/3 overlapping grid = 6/12 = 1/2.

details: Dividing by a fraction is equivalent to multiplying by its reciprocal: (a / b) / (c / d) = (a / b) * (d / c).
Dividing a whole number by a proper fraction (< 1) enlarges the quotient value.
evidence_or_examples: Maria decorating bags: 8 m / (1/4 m per bag) = 8 * 4 = 32 bags.
Water tank tap filling rate: 1 hr fills 7/10 => full tank time = 1 / (7/10) = 10/7 hours.

details: In products of the form (1 - 1/2)(1 - 1/3)(1 - 1/4)...(1 - 1/n), adjacent numerators and denominators cancel out completely.
